canonical_project: CAMTEL NBN II / Zamengoe Data Center
owner: Cameroon Telecommunications (CAMTEL) / Huawei / China Shenyang International Cooperation
notes: Zamengoe is on the outskirts of Yaounde in Centre region. DCD reported the $15m Camtel NBN II / Zamengoe facility as a 3,000 m2 Tier III-design data center built by a Chinese consortium including Huawei; News Upfront reported it operational after a July 10, 2020 ministerial visit. DC Hub reports 3.0 MW, so capacity_mw uses that third-party figure.
